note: USACE campground in blue oak woodland on the bluffs above Black Butte Lake's south shore, beside the Orland Buttes boat ramp; an 18-hole disc golf course is in the recreation area. The bank below the sites is steep. Sites 1 and 31 are 20 ft. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + catalog + availability + imagery/3DEP read. 34 sites (+ group), no hookups (the lone electric site OB14 is not bookable - electric 0), 26 sites take a 23-ft RV; $20, max stay 14; season Apr 1 - ~Sep 8 (was unknown); flush toilets and showers currently out of service (status note). LAKEVIEW CONFIRMED: west-row sites 16-20 sit on the bluff ~10 m above full pool with a steep bank. Pin OK (~125 m from the site centroid). Phone unchanged.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview CONFIRMED (kept): the west row (sites 16, 17, 18, 20, 21, 22; 39.7728-39.7736,-122.3551) sits at ~155 m on the bluff edge over open oak grassland; 3DEP falls to ~147.6 m 30 m west of site 20 and ~138.6 m 30 m west of site 16; Black Butte's gross pool is ~474 ft (~144.5 m), so full pool lies ~25-40 m from those pads but ~10 m below them down a steep bank - fails the kayak test; rec.gov: 'Direct access to the lake is limited due to steep terrain.' Imagery is drawn down (bare band below the campground). Suggested evidence: 'rec.gov sites + Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-27: west-row sites 16-22 at ~155 m on the bluff edge, full pool (~144.5 m) 25-40 m away ~10 m below down a steep bank; open oak grassland gives the sightline; rec.gov: direct lake access limited by steep terrain -> lakeview.'
HOOKUPS: electric set to 0 (was absent). rec.gov's facility text says no electric hookups; the single STANDARD ELECTRIC site OB14 is 'Not Available' and not reservable (likely the host's).

STATUS: rec.gov notice says flush toilets and showers 'will not be available' due to ongoing sanitation infrastructure issues; portable restrooms in place. Written as a status note; the facilities stay true.

SITES/FIT: count 34 -> 34 individual sites (stored note said ~33 + 1 electric). RV permitted on 28; 26 of those are 25 ft or more (OB01 and OB31 cap at 20 ft); OB10, 16, 17, 20 and 22 permit only 'Vehicle'. Stored max_rig_ft 40 (note prose) left alone: rec.gov lists RV spurs up to 115 ft, so 40 understates, but a single figure that large isn't meaningful.

SEASON END: rec.gov text 'through the second Monday in September' disagrees with its rate seasons (09-09 in 2026, 09-08 in 2027); 09-08 used, with a note. The USACE district page was not tried (it has answered Akamai 'Access Denied' to plain HTTP).
